I have found the Driver License Eligibility Requirements on the Virginia DMV website. The page is located at dmv.virginia.gov/licenses-ids/license/applying/eligibility and contains comprehensive eligibility information organized by applicant categories including:

- New Residents
- Military Personnel
- Out-of-State Students
- Non-residents
- Identification and Residency Requirements

The page also includes a First Time Drivers section and references to a document guide and DMV 141 form for determining which documents are needed when applying for a driver's license.
